marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Leading US technology conglomerates reported accelerating cloud segment growth alongside increased capital expenditure guidance directed toward AI data center capacity.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending strengthens medium-term revenue visibility for semiconductor designers and advanced packaging supply chains, despite creating short-term gross margin pressure for platform operators.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: The timeline for software-layer monetization to yield expected return on invested capital.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet & Digital Economy Majors
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed Chinese internet giants reported improved profit margins supported by operational efficiency and steady recovery in digital advertising.
marketLayer.inference: Enhanced free cash flow and persistent share buyback programs provide strong valuation downside protection, though top-line acceleration remains contingent on macroeconomic tailwinds.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of mainland consumer spending momentum and competitive dynamics in domestic e-commerce.

marketLayer.title: Electric Vehicle & New Energy Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Chinese NEV manufacturers announced additional price promotional strategies to expand domestic market presence while expanding export shipments.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerating industry consolidation will likely concentrate market share among top-tier producers with cost leadership, while secondary brands face margin compression.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential revisions to overseas trade tariffs and regional protectionist policies.
